_comment: Copy to your data volume as operators.json (SAFESPACE_OPERATORS_FILE=/data/operators.json). Maps each VERIFIED Tailscale login → operator policy. Default-deny: a login not listed here is refused (403). tailnetLogin = the WhoIs UserProfile.LoginName (case-insensitive). operatorId = ^[A-Za-z0-9_.-]{1,64}$ (the audit actor). tier ∈ read|write|share. allowedAccounts = the consented Google accounts this operator may use ([] = none); every entry must be a consented account in accounts.json or the server refuses to start. OPTIONAL writeBurstLimit / deleteBurstLimit (v1.92, integer 1–100000) = this operator's per-operator F1 burst caps; omit to use the global SAFESPACE_WRITE_BURST_LIMIT / SAFESPACE_DELETE_BURST_LIMIT default. Note the F1 cap is now PER-OPERATOR, so the aggregate process write rate is roughly (operator count × default) — size the default accordingly.
